name: Kusunoki Yuma
source: A very kind and frail girl. Has "Gleam" power of "Psychometry" (Some sort of ESP characterized by the claimed ability to make relevant associations from an object of unknown history by making physical contact with that object.). Has a hobby of reading BL novel and manga.
